archetypes.name: cross-doc-consistency
archetypes.rationale: Verify that SKILL.md and approval-gates.md carry identical bypass lists, Step 3.6 routing decisions, and breadcrumb strings for every Step 3 exit status
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine every Step 3 exit path enumerated in the plan (converged, cap-hit, panel-failed, tally-error, degraded-empty-collector, cap-reached, plan-size-trigger, plan-validator-defects, main-agent-vote-required, complete, revision-failed, emit-plan-failed) and confirm that SKILL.md and approval-gates.md carry strictly identical bypass lists, settled-path lists, and breadcrumb strings for each status. Flag any status that appears in one file but not the other, any breadcrumb string that differs between files, or any routing decision that is present in SKILL.md Step 3.6 but absent from approval-gates.md or vice versa. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: status-enumeration
archetypes.rationale: Confirm every Step 3 exit status is covered exactly once across route-through, skip-with-breadcrumb, and explicitly-justified-other categories with no gaps or duplicates
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the eleven Step 3 exit statuses named in the plan (converged, cap-hit, panel-failed, tally-error, degraded-empty-collector, cap-reached, plan-size-trigger, plan-validator-defects, main-agent-vote-required, complete, revision-failed, emit-plan-failed) each appear in exactly one routing category in the updated SKILL.md Step 3.6 and in test-design-structure.sh structural pins, with no status omitted, duplicated across categories, or handled by a catch-all that silently swallows unknown future statuses. Also verify that test-assess-plan-round.sh covers the passive-summary Continue path and Step 3.5 bypass list completeness as stated in the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-fixture-isolation
archetypes.rationale: Validate that new integration cases in test-assess-plan-round.sh use case-local mock stubs, reset only before each case, and write run-params.json to case_tmp not the shared TMP
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the two new integration cases added to test-assess-plan-round.sh and confirm that each case allocates its own case_tmp directory for mock stubs and run-params.json rather than writing to the shared TMP, that the reset boundary occurs strictly before each case and not between individual entries within a case, and that no stale artifact from one case can influence the next. Check whether any mock stub path or verdict file written during one case leaks into the shared fixture space visible to subsequent cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
